<noinclude>{{SbcHeaderLojbanPod|title=Cheers!|id=A0041}}</noinclude>
{{SbcIntroductionLojbanPod}}
Here is a true story: the first time I tried to say “cheers” in Lojban, I said “que aproveche,” which means “enjoy your meal” and is just wrong when everyone is drinking instead of eating. Well, it's from our mistakes that we learn. And from JP and Liliana, of course. The keyword of this lesson is: '''felicidades''' – congratulations.
{{SbcSourceLojbanPod|[[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0001|A0001: Are you ready yet?]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0003|A0003: At the bar]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0015|A0015: Table for two]]}}

{{SbcExercisesLojbanPod}}
<noinclude>====Dialogue Translation====
Translate from Lojban to English. Click each bar to check your answer. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| '''¡Toma una copa!'''
| Take a drink!
| '''¿Por qué brindamos?'''
| What are we toasting to?
| '''Por mi nuevo trabajo.'''
| To my new job.
| '''¡Felicidades!'''
| Congratulations!
| '''¡Salud!'''
| Cheers!
| '''¡Salud!'''
| Cheers!
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Translation====

<noinclude>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestion
| Do you want a drink? Take (it)!
| '''¿Quieres una copa? ¡Toma!'''
| Why?
| '''¿Por qué?'''
| We drink to my new job.
| '''Brindamos por mi nuevo trabajo.'''
| Congratulations!
| '''¡Felicidades!'''
| Cheers!
| '''¡Salud!'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Remix====
